effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Main Phase] If you have a Digimon with the [Cyborg] or [Machine] trait in play, gain 1 memory.
[All Turns] When one of your Digimon with the [Cyborg] or [Machine] trait becomes suspended, you may suspend this Tamer to ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) Then, trash 1 card from your hand.
